subject: general
question: X spends 16% of his income on travel, 40% on groceries and 14% on family medical expenses every month. He is left with a sum of ₹ 9,630. Find his annual income.
solution:
**Given:**

X spends 16% of his income on travel, 40% on groceries, and 14% on family medical expenses every month. He is left with a sum of ₹9,630.

**Formula used:**

Total monthly expenses percentage = 16% + 40% + 14%

Savings percentage = 100% - Total monthly expenses percentage

Monthly income = Savings amount / (Savings percentage / 100)</p&g
